findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "tarot" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tarot_cards, post_tarot_daily, post_tarot_yes_no, post_tarot_spreads_career · Private data: post_tarot_daily · Public sink: post_tarot_draw, post_tarot_daily, post_tarot_yes_no, post_tarot_spreads_three_card, post_tarot_spreads_celtic_cross, post_tarot_spreads_love, post_tarot_spreads_career, post_tarot_spreads_custom · Destructive: get_tarot_cards_id.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tarot_cards, post_tarot_daily, post_tarot_yes_no, post_tarot_spreads_career · Private data: post_tarot_daily · Public sink: post_tarot_draw, post_tarot_daily, post_tarot_yes_no, post_tarot_spreads_three_card, post_tarot_spreads_celtic_cross, post_tarot_spreads_love, post_tarot_spreads_career, post_tarot_spreads_custom · Destructive: get_tarot_cards_id

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
